locator: can. IV.3, Si quis dixerit, fieri posse, ut dogmatibus ab Ecclesia propositis ... sensus tribuendus sit alius
interpretation: Can. IV.3: 'Si quis dixerit, fieri posse, ut dogmatibus ab Ecclesia propositis, aliquando secundum progressum scientiae sensus tribuendus sit alius ab eo, quem intellexit et intelligit Ecclesia; anathema sit.' The canon condemns the claim that a dogma may receive another sense; it states the binding of the declared sense negatively.
attribution: The passage states that whoever says that dogmas proposed by the Church may, with the progress of science, be given a sense other than the one the Church has understood is anathema, which is the premise read as its negative form.
